Usage: aeat config profile create [OPTIONS] PROFILE_NAME                      
                                                                               
 Initialize a new active profile.                                              
                                                                               
┌─ Arguments ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ *    profile_name      TEXT  Profile name to write the answers into         │
│                              [required]                                     │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Options ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --quiet                    Run non-interactively using only the supplied    │
│                            flag values; required flags left unset cause an  │
│                            error. Sufficient on its own; combine with       │
│                            --accept-defaults to fill the rest from          │
│                            descriptor defaults.                             │
│ --accept-defaults          Fill every unsupplied flag from the descriptor   │
│                            defaults, without prompting. Use alongside       │
│                            --quiet, or on its own for an all-defaults       │
│                            create.                                          │
│ --help                     Show this message and exit.                      │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Taxpayer type ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --entity-type                            natural_person|l  Natural person,  │
│                                          egal_entity|attr  legal entity, or │
│                                          ibution_entity    attribution      │
│                                                            entity           │
│ --legal-entity-f…                        sl|sa|sal|sll|co  Recognised legal │
│                                          operativa|socied  form when the    │
│                                          ad_civil_mercant  entity type is a │
│                                          il|sin_fines_luc  legal entity     │
│                                          rativos|other                      │
│ --irpf-income-ca…                        actividad_econom  IRPF income      │
│                                          ica|trabajo|capi  category; pass   │
│                                          tal_inmobiliario  --irpf-income-c… │
│                                          |capital_mobilia  once per         │
│                                          rio|ganancias_pa  category         │
│                                          trimoniales|pens                   │
│                                          ion                                │
│ --incn-prior-12-…                        TEXT              Net turnover     │
│                                                            (importe neto de │
│                                                            la cifra de      │
│                                                            negocios) over   │
│                                                            the prior 12     │
│                                                            months, in       │
│                                                            euros. Above     │
│                                                            6,000,000 EUR    │
│                                                            Modelo 202       │
│                                                            mandates the     │
│                                                            Art. 40.3 LIS    │
│                                                            modality; below  │
│                                                            it both          │
│                                                            modalities are   │
│                                                            available.       │
│                                                            Optional.        │
│ --new-entity-fir…    --no-new-entity…                      Mark this when a │
│                                                            newly-created    │
│                                                            legal entity is  │
│                                                            in one of its    │
│                                                            first two        │
│                                                            profit-making    │
│                                                            tax periods (LIS │
│                                                            Art. 29) to opt  │
│                                                            into the 15      │
│                                                            percent reduced  │
│                                                            rate. Optional;  │
│                                                            unset leaves the │
│                                                            entity on its    │
│                                                            otherwise-appli… │
│                                                            rate.            │
│ --ley-49-2002-op…    --no-ley-49-200…                      Record whether   │
│                                                            Modelo 036       │
│                                                            casilla 651      │
│                                                            declares the Ley │
│                                                            49/2002 Title II │
│                                                            option.          │
│ --ley-49-2002-op…                        TEXT              Record the       │
│                                                            Modelo 036       │
│                                                            casilla 653 date │
│                                                            for the Ley      │
│                                                            49/2002 Title II │
│                                                            option.          │
│ --ley-49-2002-re…    --no-ley-49-200…                      Record whether   │
│                                                            Modelo 036       │
│                                                            casilla 652      │
│                                                            declares         │
│                                                            renunciation of  │
│                                                            the Ley 49/2002  │
│                                                            Title II regime. │
│ --ley-49-2002-re…                        TEXT              Record the       │
│                                                            Modelo 036       │
│                                                            casilla 654 date │
│                                                            for the Ley      │
│                                                            49/2002 Title II │
│                                                            renunciation.    │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Profile identity ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --tax-id                     TEXT         Tax identifier (NIF/CIF/DNI/NIE)  │
│                                           for the active profile            │
│ --name                       TEXT         Display name shown in local       │
│                                           reviews                           │
│ --surnames                   TEXT         Surnames or company name for      │
│                                           export headers                    │
│ --legal-name                 TEXT         Legal or company name for         │
│                                           legal-entity export headers       │
│ --activity                   TEXT         Business activity as plain text,  │
│                                           or the IAE heading if you know it │
│ --address-postcode           TEXT         Tax address postcode              │
│ --activity-start-date        TEXT         Censo registration /              │
│                                           start-of-activity date            │
│                                           (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional; when set, │
│                                           obligations for periods before    │
│                                           this date are not shown.          │
│ --taxation-type              1|2          Income-tax return type: 1 =       │
│                                           individual, 2 = joint (family     │
│                                           unit).                            │
│ --output-language            es|en|ca|hu  CLI output language for this      │
│                                           profile                           │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ First taxpayer ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --taxpayer-sex                H|M                    First taxpayer sex: H  │
│                                                      = male, M = female.    │
│ --taxpayer-marital-st…        1|2|3|4|5              First taxpayer marital │
│                                                      status: 1 = single, 2  │
│                                                      = married, 3 =         │
│                                                      widowed, 4 = separated │
│                                                      or divorced, 5 =       │
│                                                      registered civil       │
│                                                      partnership.           │
│ --situacion-familiar          casado|pareja_hecho_r  Family situation under │
│                               egistrada|pareja_hech  Art. 82 LIRPF:         │
│                               o_no_registrada|solte  determines whether     │
│                               ro|separado_divorciad  joint taxation is      │
│                               o                      available and which    │
│                                                      family unit variant    │
│                                                      applies.               │
│ --taxpayer-marriage-d…        TEXT                   Start date of the      │
│                                                      current marriage       │
│                                                      (YYYY-MM-DD). Only     │
│                                                      when marital status =  │
│                                                      2 (married). Derives   │
│                                                      casillas               │
│                                                      0245/0246/0247         │
│                                                      (matrimonio            │
│                                                      sobrevenido, Art. 82   │
│                                                      LIRPF).                │
│ --taxpayer-birth-date         TEXT                   First taxpayer birth   │
│                                                      date                   │
│ --taxpayer-disability…        1|2|3|4                First taxpayer         │
│                                                      disability grade: 1 =  │
│                                                      33%-64%, 2 = 65% or    │
│                                                      higher, 3 = judicial   │
│                                                      incapacity, 4 =        │
│                                                      third-party assistance │
│                                                      or reduced mobility.   │
│ --taxpayer-death-date         TEXT                   First taxpayer death   │
│                                                      date                   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Spouse ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --spouse-tax-id                                TEXT     Spouse NIF/NIE      │
│ --spouse-name                                  TEXT     Spouse given name   │
│ --spouse-surnames                              TEXT     Spouse surnames     │
│ --spouse-birth-date                            TEXT     Spouse birth date   │
│ --spouse-sex                                   H|M      Spouse sex: H =     │
│                                                         male, M = female.   │
│ --spouse-disability…                           1|2|3|4  Spouse disability   │
│                                                         grade (if           │
│                                                         applicable): 1 =    │
│                                                         33%-64%, 2 = 65% or │
│                                                         higher, 3 =         │
│                                                         judicial            │
│                                                         incapacity, 4 =     │
│                                                         third-party         │
│                                                         assistance or       │
│                                                         reduced mobility.   │
│ --spouse-non-reside…    --no-spouse-non-re…             Spouse is           │
│                                                         non-resident IRPF   │
│ --spouse-eu-eea-res…    --no-spouse-eu-eea…             Spouse is EU/EEA    │
│                                                         resident            │
│ --spouse-eu-eea-cou…                           TEXT     Spouse EU/EEA       │
│                                                         country             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Family unit ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --family-descendants-…    --no-family-descenda…      EU/EEA descendants in  │
│                                                      family-unit deduction  │
│ --family-minor-childr…    --no-family-minor-ch…      Minor children in      │
│                                                      family unit            │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ IVA ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --iva-regime                             GENERAL|SIMPLIF  IVA regime        │
│                                          ICADO|RECARGO_E                    │
│                                          QUIVALENCIA|REA                    │
│                                          GP|EXENTO                          │
│ --iva-roi-enroll…    --no-iva-roi-en…                     Enrolled in ROI   │
│ --iva-oss-enroll…    --no-iva-oss-en…                     Enrolled in OSS   │
│ --iva-group-memb…    --no-iva-group-…                     Enrolled as a     │
│                                                           member entity of  │
│                                                           an IVA group      │
│ --iva-group-domi…    --no-iva-group-…                     Enrolled as the   │
│                                                           dominant entity   │
│                                                           of an IVA group   │
│ --iva-sii-enroll…    --no-iva-sii-en…                     Whether the       │
│                                                           taxpayer is       │
│                                                           enrolled in the   │
│                                                           SII               │
│ --iva-redeme-enr…    --no-iva-redeme…                     Whether the       │
│                                                           taxpayer is       │
│                                                           registered in     │
│                                                           REDEME            │
│ --iva-intracommu…    --no-iva-intrac…                     Intra-community   │
│                                                           operations exceed │
│                                                           50,000 EUR        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Enrollment ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --enrollment-large-co…    --no-enrollment-larg…      Large-company          │
│                                                      enrollment             │
│ --enrollment-public-a…    --no-enrollment-publ…      Public administration  │
│                                                      budget over 6,000,000  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Modelo obligations ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --has-employees      --no-has-employ…                      Has employees    │
│                                                            and pays         │
│                                                            salaries with    │
│                                                            retención        │
│ --pays-professio…    --no-pays-profe…                      Pays             │
│                                                            professionals    │
│                                                            with retención   │
│ --art109-activit…    --no-art109-act…                      Art. 109         │
│                                                            coverage - at    │
│                                                            least 70% of     │
│                                                            covered          │
│                                                            professional,    │
│                                                            agricultural,    │
│                                                            livestock, or    │
│                                                            forestry         │
│                                                            activity income  │
│                                                            subject to       │
│                                                            withholding or   │
│                                                            payment on       │
│                                                            account          │
│ --pays-rent-with…    --no-pays-rent-…                      Pays local rent  │
│                                                            with retención   │
│ --pays-capital-i…    --no-pays-capit…                      Pays capital     │
│                                                            income with      │
│                                                            retención        │
│ --modelo-111-no-…                        TEXT              Comma-separated  │
│                                                            Modelo 111       │
│                                                            no-obligation    │
│                                                            periods, format  │
│                                                            YYYY:PERIOD (for │
│                                                            example          │
│                                                            2025:2T,2025:3T… │
│                                                            Use only when no │
│                                                            subject payments │
│                                                            were made.       │
│ --irpf-estimatio…                        directa_normal|d  IRPF estimation  │
│                                          irecta_simplific  regime for       │
│                                          ada|objetiva      economic-activi… │
│                                                            income           │
│ --objective-esti…                        TEXT              IAE epigraph for │

│                                                            972.             │
│ --objective-esti…                        TEXT              Annual module 1  │

│                                                            objective-estim… │
│                                                            modules.         │

│                                                            objective-estim… │
│                                                            modules.         │
│ --objective-esti…                        TEXT              Annual module 3  │

│                                                            objective-estim… │
│                                                            modules.         │

│                                                            objective-estim… │

│                                                            objective-estim… │

│ --irpf-special-r…                        general|impatria  IRPF special     │
│                                          do                regime.          │
│                                                            "general" for    │
│                                                            most taxpayers.  │
│                                                            "impatriado" for │
│                                                            workers who      │
│                                                            relocated to     │
│                                                            Spain and        │
│                                                            elected the      │
│                                                            Beckham Law      │

│                                                            elected the      │
│                                                            inpatriate       │
│                                                            regime           │
│                                                            (YYYY-MM-DD).    │
│                                                            Only when        │
│                                                            irpf-special-re… │

│                                                            The regime       │
│                                                            expires at the   │
│                                                            end of the 6th   │
│                                                            calendar year.   │

│                                                      representative in      │
